messages:
alex (partnerships): Heads-up: HelixEdge listing failed final onboarding check. Marketplace portal shows vendor EIN 12-3456789 but their W-9 and vendor onboarding form list 98-7654321. Procurement refuses to issue PO until EIN reconciled. Also their marketplace EDI alias is 77700 while the PO pipeline expects 55500.

dina (sales): Oh no. We told them to expect POs this week. Did they ever give us an alternate remit address?

alex (partnerships): They provided a reseller certificate that references HelixEdge Resale Co. The partner is trying to route invoicing through the reseller and not the product company.

noah-legal: Can we accept reseller invoices on first deal? We typically require either a signed reseller agreement + sub-contractor declaration or direct vendor invoicing.

sam-finance: For accounting and tax we need EIN match on the vendor master to process vendor payments automatically. If the reseller is doing the invoicing we need a reseller MSA and a W-9 for the actual payee. Otherwise invoices go to exceptions and payments delay.

emi (partner-ops): I've asked HelixEdge to upload a copy of the W-9 and the vendor account screenshot showing EDI alias 55500. They say the marketplace UI shows 55500 on their side but the portal API returns 77700. Thinks it's a mapping bug.

marketplace-bot: (auto-note) Support ticket MKP-8899 created. Assigned to marketplace-infra. Triage ETA 2h.

alex (partnerships): Quick plan: 1) Ask partner to upload W-9 + remit letter + screenshot into the ticket. 2) Marketplace infra to confirm canonical alias and sync API. 3) Finance to provision manual payment path only if we get all legal docs. 4) Sales to notify launch timeline may slip.

dina (sales): I'll message partner: short note. "We need W-9 + confirmation of invoice remit entity and EDI alias in portal by EOD or we hold launch."

noah-legal: Draft language for reseller acceptance if partner wants reseller to bill:```We need (a) signed reseller agreement referencing Redwood Inference, (b) signed indemnity for pass-through billing, and (c) W-9 for the invoicing entity.```

sam-finance: If the partner provides W-9 + reseller agreement we can set up a temporary manual approval in the vendor master but payments will still route through the exceptions queue for first 30 days. We'll alert AR team.

emi (partner-ops): Marketplace support responded: suspected stale alias cache. They will run a sync job after receiving vendor account ID. Asked HelixEdge to paste the vendor ID into MKP-8899.

alex (partnerships): Action items: Dina -> get W-9 + vendor ID by 6pm PST. Emi -> ping MKP-8899 and escalate to @mkt-sre if no sync within 2h. Sam -> prepare manual instruction for AP when exception occurs. Noah -> stand by to approve reseller wording.

dina (sales): On it. Looping in HelixEdge finance now.

marketplace-bot: (auto-note) MKP-8899 status update: triaged -> awaiting vendor ID from partner.

alex (partnerships): If we can't reconcile EIN by EOD, propose delaying the public listing. Better to delay than have invoices stuck.

sam-finance: Agreed. Cash flow implications for partner are their problem but we should avoid support noise. I'll draft the exception notice to AP now.

dina (sales): Partner replied: will upload W-9 + screenshot within 90 minutes. Posting proof when done. :raised_hands:

alex (partnerships): Great — keep thread updated. If marketplace infra confirms alias sync and W-9 matches EIN 12-3456789 we can proceed without reseller docs. If not, follow the reseller path Noah outlined.
